name: Quick Start with Vue (Free)
summary: Guide to installing @hugeicons/vue and the free icon package, then rendering icons in a Vue 3 or Nuxt app.
description: A quick-start guide for Hugeicons Free in Vue: prerequisites, installing @hugeicons/vue and @hugeicons/core-free-icons, then rendering a first icon. The free package holds 6,000+ icons in one style (stroke rounded); size, color and strokeWidth are props on the icon component.
contains: free package: 6,000+ icons in one style (stroke rounded)
works with Vue 3 (Vite, Nuxt, Vue CLI)
